description: This PHP source file defines the DataGroupAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints related to Data Groups in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods to get all data group permissions and placeholders for create and delete operations, following RESTful principles.

classes.name: DataGroupAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing data groups within the OrangeHRM system. Implements retrieval of all data group permissions and stubs for create and delete operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all data group permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method (none in this case).

methods.name: create
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a new data group; currently not implemented.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for create operation (not implemented).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting a data group; currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation (not implemented).
